custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test at the test location with a Sell Price of $20.00.
  • Create a part, part B, for this test at location B only, so its separate entry's number is one the test location does not stock.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. To switch: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425712-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425712-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 2:

  • Part Number shows part B's number.

Step 3:

  • Sell Price shows 25.00.

Step 4:

  • Inactive is selected.

Step 5:

  • The "Deactivate part?" confirmation opens.

Step 6:

  • The confirmation closes, and the part window shows the refusal "Part number" followed by part B's number and "already belongs to another part in the Part Library." (part B is stocked at location B).

Step 7:

  • The part window closes.

Step 8:

  • Part A is still listed on the Active tab under its own number.

Step 9:

  • Sell Price reads 20.00 and Part Status reads Active: nothing was saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-N5: “If saving the form is refused while the confirmation is open, the confirmation closes, the dialog shows the refusal, and nothing is saved.”
  • S13-N1: “If another Part Library entry already has exactly the typed number, with the same characters and the same upper and lower case, the save is refused, the dialog stays open, and the system shows "Part number {number} already belongs to another part in the Part Library."”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
